# BasketballExposureevents API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Authentication
Unknown (may need login) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /agrp/prod/{prodToken}` — Authenticate and obtain a production token.

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /{id}/sodar` — Retrieve exposure event data by ID.
- `GET /display/{displayId}/{displayId}` — Retrieve display data by display ID.
- `GET /sadbundle/{sadbundleId}/728x90.json` — Get 728x90 ad data from a sadbundle.

### Data Write (5)
- `POST /.well-known/private-aggregation/report-shared-storage` — Report private aggregation data to shared storage.
- `POST /{id}` — Create or update exposure event data by ID.
- `POST /data/cors` — Post data using CORS.
- `POST /frontendevents/dl` — Send frontend event data.
- `POST /organizations/{organizationId}/{organizationId}` — Post data related to an organization.

### Media (3)
- `GET /assets/files/jpg/{jpgId}` — Retrieve a JPG image asset by ID.
- `GET /assets/files/png/{pngId}` — Retrieve a PNG image asset by ID.
- `GET /assets/sports/basketball/icons/0` — Retrieve a basketball icon asset.

### Config (1)
- `GET /embeddable/config` — Get configuration settings for embedded events.

}

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Basketball Exposureevents's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Basketball Exposureevents data without official API access
- Automate actions on basketball.exposureevents.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Basketball Exposureevents frontend uses
